_note: v5-fused = sigmoid(a0 + a*logit(vegas) + b*logit(v1)/temper + w(h)*c*injury_points), fit on this project's own graded rows by `npm run v5:fit` (ridge toward the priors, leave-one-week-out). Priors: a and b are v3-anchor's weights written as a plain blend (1-lambda, lambda; v3's lambda already applies to the tempered logit), c is v4's logit-per-point. temper is v3's. injury_points comes from v4.1's source-layered adjustment. w(h) fades the injury term from full at 72h before kickoff to zero at kickoff, because the line absorbs injury news during the week. Approved by Drew 2026-11-09. The snapshot skips v5 with a warning until fitted_at is set; once v5 rows exist, v5:fit refuses to run and any refit is a new model_version.
